name: none-sibling-fixture
description: #198 C1 — a `none` cross-lib `code is` SIBLING. main.crl (code is + decision) chains `recommend activity "Sib"."Approve"` into sib.crl, which has `code is` + an activity but NO decision → the per-CRL `none` path. Pre-C1 its base Library kept the bare `<policyId>` id while its CodeSystem was disambiguated (`<policyId>-sib-local`) — inconsistent + latently colliding. Option B C1 gives the base Library the disambiguated unified identity.
